title: Why the Doomsday X-Men Reunion Wasn't One Big Reunion
excerpt:
Returning X-Men actors did not necessarily film together.
Alan Cumming describes a more fragmented production experience.
body_md:
Avengers: Doomsday brings back several performers associated with the original X-Men films, but the production did not always resemble the full ensemble reunion fans imagined. Alan Cumming, returning as Nightcrawler after X2, has explained that cast members often worked on separate sets and in different locations.

Cumming has previously discussed the demanding makeup involved in his original appearance and described his latest experience more positively. Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, James Marsden and Rebecca Romijn are among the familiar faces associated with the franchise's earlier era.

Marsden has expressed enthusiasm about reconnecting with former colleagues, while Romijn described playing Mystique again as surreal. The logistics of filming separately should not be mistaken for personal tensions. The film is scheduled for December 18, 2026.
